title: Where I'd like to live
standfirst: Dans le futur, je voudrais habiter… — and the three mistakes it invites.
summary: The sentence that gets the top mark, plus a reason with parce que.

vocab.en: Where would you like to live?
I would like to live in Spain.

vocab.fr: Dans le futur, je voudrais habiter…
vocab.en: In the future, I would like to live…

rules.body: je voudrais habiter, never habite. Two verbs in a row and the second one stays in its -er form.
Dans le futur — masculine, so le. La futur is one of the easiest slips in the whole topic, which is why it is on the tricky spellings list.

rules.lead: The same à / en / au rule as Pack 4
rules.body: Nothing new to learn here — habiter en Espagne, habiter au Japon, exactly as before.

notes.body: A full sentence with a connective and a reason is what the speaking mark scheme is asking for. Dans le futur, je voudrais habiter en Italie parce qu'il fait chaud does all of it at once.
